title: 緊急狀況溝通
description: 各種緊急狀況下的溝通表達

sentences.en: Fire! Get out of the building!
There's an earthquake! Get under a table!
sentences.zh: 地震了！快躲到桌子底下！

sentences.en: It's dangerous here, we need to leave.
sentences.zh: 這裡很危險，我們得離開。

sentences.en: There's a gas leak in this building.
Follow me to the safe area.
Don't use the elevator during a fire.
Cover your mouth with a wet cloth.
The building is about to collapse.

sentences.zh: 我們被困住了，需要救援。

sentences.en: Do you have an emergency kit?
The tsunami warning has been issued.
Keep low to avoid the smoke.
Can you hear me? Are you trapped?
sentences.zh: 你聽得到我嗎？你被困住了嗎？

sentences.en: The rescue team is on the way.
Take only your essentials and leave now.
sentences.zh: 只帶必需品，現在就離開。
